about: Hand-labelled call sites for scoring Cortex's CALLS edges on real code (c12.1; Kotlin, C#, JavaScript, Ruby and PHP packages added in c15.3). Sites are sampled by docs/evaluations/graph/sample_sites.py from the grammar's call nodes; labels were assigned by Claude reading the pinned source and are open to correction. Rules: `internal` = the call resolves statically to a definition in the indexed package (target is file:Cortex-local-name); calls on self/this/super resolve by method lookup from the enclosing class, ignoring subclass overrides; `external` = standard library or third-party; `undeterminable` = dynamic dispatch with no single static target (callbacks, configurable attributes, virtual or interface calls with several implementations).
